introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Hold this position for seconds.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe slowly while holding yourself up.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Please bring your bottom waist away from the floor.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Please bring your bottom waist away from the floor.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your hands underneath your hips.\n\nSlightly lift your legs and shoulders, and then alternately cross your legs over one another.
name: CRISSCROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your abs tight.
Please keep your feet off the ground.
Don’t forget to breathe.
Try to keep your legs as straight as you can.
It’s a good exercise for your abs and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground and hands underneath your hips. \n\nRaise your legs to the tabletop position; drop your left foot towards the ground. Tap the ground with your toes; then raise the leg back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knee steady as you drop your leg towards the ground.
Exhale as you drop your leg; inhale as you bring it back.

introduce:
Lie on a mat with your arms extended by your sides and your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.

Draw your navel in toward your spine. Slowly lower your legs to one side.

Engage your core and lift your legs back up, rotating them in an arc to the opposite side and back down to the starting position.

Repeat on the other side.
name: CORKSCREW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down on the mat.
Please inhale as you prepare and exhale as you twist or rotate your legs.
Breathe consistently and avoid holding your breath.
This exercise helps strengthen and stabilize the core.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back. Engage your core, curl your head and shoulders off the mat and bring both knees into your chest.

Extend your left leg out straight. Hold onto your bent leg, with your outside hand on your knee and your inside hand on your ankle.

Switch legs, bending the left leg and extending your right leg. Repeat the exercise, alternating sides.
name: SINGLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please use your abs to do the move instead of pulling your legs.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep a neutral spine position.
The exercise challenges the deep abdominal muscles.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended into the air. Lift your shoulders off the mat with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Inhale through your nose for a count of 5, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 5 while simultaneously pumping your arms up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: THE HUNDRED

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please control your breathing and your movements.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
This exercise can strengthen your core and back.
